mentions.name: TractionBeast
mentions.description: A tool that delivers bite-sized go-to-market tasks to founders every day, which they simply review and complete, removing the inertia around getting customers. Originally built for the author's own use and turned into a product after founder friends liked it.
mentions.problem: Founders procrastinate on go-to-market tasks because they would rather be building, so traction work stalls.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I created https://tractionbeast.com/ as a tool for myself. It gives me bite-sized tasks every day. I just review and do them. This completely removes the inertia for me. My other founder-friends like it too so I turned it into a product.

evidence.value: So I created https://tractionbeast.com/ as a tool for myself. It gives me bite-sized tasks every day. I just review and do them. This completely removes the inertia for me. My other founder-friends like it too so I turned it into a product.
